Subject: Mutual Action Plan: multi-tier onramp & region decision (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Claire / Raj —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I attached a first-pass MAP that breaks the evaluation into two parallel tracks: a short onramp (hosted API + fallbacks) to unblock pilot traffic, and a mid-term lane (dedicated capacity or private VPC) if you need PHI isolation and predictable throughput.

Quick summary of what's in the MAP workbook:
- Week 1–2: pilot using Hosted API in us-east-1 (smoke tests, latency profiling)
- Week 3–4: dedicated capacity sizing run (baseline throughput, cost delta)
- Week 5–6: Private deployment feasibility (VPC peering, KMS review)
- Decision checkpoint: choose "pilot-only (Hosted)" or escalate to "Dedicated" or "Private" by 2026-05-20

Open questions for your team (please flag owners in the MAP sheet):
1) Will pilot traffic contain PHI? (impacts whether we recommend Dedicated or Private)
2) Required RTO / RPO for inference (latency SLOs)
3) Any procurement/contract timing constraints for Dedicated capacity?

Attached: MedCure_MAP_v1.xlsx and our SOC2 checklist PDF (SOC2-questions.pdf). I copied Priyom (solutions) and Hannah (your SE lead) — they can help scope the dedicated sizing and the private deployment checklist.

Next steps proposed:
- You: quick confirmation on PHI and procurement timeline by Tue 5/18
- Priyom: run a short sizing exercise after we get sample QPS and token lengths
- Jonas: consolidate MAP and lock a decision reminder for 5/20

Thanks — look forward to your notes.

—Jonas Weber

Thanks Jonas — this looks very helpful. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Pilot traffic will include limited PHI (de-identified at source for 80% of calls, but some records will include PHI during edge cases).
- Latency target is median sub-200ms for chat flows, p95 under 600ms.
- Procurement: we can sign short-term terms for pilot; procurement cycle for Dedicated/Private would take ~6–8 weeks once we decide.

I'll add owners in the MAP sheet today. For the decision checkpoint, can we also include an ops-runbook snippet for failover behavior if we start on Hosted and need to route to Dedicated mid-pilot?

Claire Zhao
Head of Product — MedCure Health
From: priyom.das@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: multi-tier onramp & region decision (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Claire / team —

Good notes. Quick responses and asks from the solutions side:

1) PHI in pilot: if you expect any PHI we should treat the pilot as PHI-bearing for architecture. That pushes best-practice toward Dedicated (reserved GPU pool with VPC options) or Private for full-airgap. Hosted can work if you accept data handling controls and sign the BAA, but it increases complexity for edge-case PHI routing.

2) Latency SLOs: Achievable from both Hosted and Dedicated; Dedicated gives tighter p95 at scale due to reduced noisy neighbors. We'll need sample QPS, typical prompt lengths, and median session lengths to size batch windows. Could MedCure share a 48-hour sample trace (token-level) to run a quick simulation?

3) Ops-runbook snippet: I drafted a short failover approach — Hosted as primary for pilot, with a canary Dedicated pool warmed with cached KV prefixes for critical flows. If p95 breaches the agreed threshold for two consecutive hours we route new sessions to Dedicated while fallback continues. I pasted the snippet into the MAP tab called "FailoverOps_v0".

Attachments referenced in thread: MedCure_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated with FailoverOps_v0 tab).

Timeline note: Given procurement lag, we can plan a Dedicated cutover (if chosen) in 6–8 weeks; Private will take longer due to network and KMS approvals.

—Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: claire@medcure.io
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: multi-tier onramp & region decision (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Team —

After reviewing the MAP and the embedded ops snippet, leadership at MedCure has directed us to proceed with a two-phase approach:

Phase A (Pilot, immediate): Start pilot on Hosted API in us-east-1 with the Hosted SOC2 controls in place and a signed BAA. We'll treat the pilot as PHI-bearing for safety, but accept the operational mitigations you suggested.

Phase B (Contingent, mid-term): Parallel sizing and procurement for a Dedicated pool in us-east-1. If the production-like load and latency telemetry indicate we cannot meet p95 targets within 3 weeks of pilot start, we will activate Dedicated. Target decision date for activating Dedicated remains 2026-06-10.

Please update the MAP to reflect this path and share an updated mutual-action checklist with key owners and procurement trigger dates. Also confirm next steps on the BAA and SOC2 evidence request (we expect the SOC2 questions PDF was an initial drop).

I'll mark Raj and Maya as procurement / security owners.

Thanks — Claire
